Assam Floods Cause Widespread Damage, Displacement, and Deaths

Floods in Assam have resulted in the deaths of at least 104 people, affecting over 78,000 individuals across more than 2,600 villages. Thousands have been displaced and forced into relief camps. The floods have caused significant loss of livestock and crops, with residents expressing fear and awaiting aid. Medical teams are organizing health relief camps for affected populations, while some reports suggest the flood situation is improving, though a large number remain impacted.
